description: Land Titile Settlement Department  - Suwarapola, Kesbewa, Colombo District  - Cad. Map No. 521201
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on property ownership and land title settlements, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
